LanguageData.HD_CQBTraining.label: CQB training
LanguageData.HD_CQBTraining.description: Temporary training qualification for testing close-quarters and tactical shooting skills.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalAim_CommandDesc: Keep watching a chosen point. Aim direction follows that point as you move. The 90-degree focus arc grants faster warmup; outside it, warmup is slower. Moving fire is limited to a 120-degree arc.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalAim_RetargetDesc: Choose a new point to watch.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalAim_OutsideArc: The target is outside the firing arc.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalMovement_CommandDesc: Choose the movement firing tradeoff. Accuracy retention greatly increases Warmup; response retention keeps Warmup closer to normal but reduces accuracy.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalHighSpeed_CommandDesc: Move up to 12 cells at roughly 200% speed. Firing and aiming are unavailable during the movement, while enemies suffer reduced accuracy against the moving pawn.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalHighSpeed_InvalidTarget: The high-speed movement destination is invalid.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalHighSpeed_AimDisabled: High-speed movement cannot be used while aiming.
